speaker: Doctor
text:
The echocardiogram confirms an atrial septal defect with a left-to-right shunt, which explains your heart enlargement. The significant rapid breathing and leg swelling are likely due to the increased pulmonary blood flow and eventual right heart strain (Eisenmenger physiology) or chronic volume overload. Have you noticed any episodes of fainting, palpitations, or cyanosis during exertion?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Heart Disease (Atrial Septal Defect) with complications of pulmonary hypertension and right ventricular failure.
